annotations.upgrade_relay: Call the tool first: a gated result carries a session-bound checkout link (dchub.cloud/go/c/<token>) and a human relay (dchub.cloud/upgrade/h/<token>) minted for THIS session — relay those verbatim. This URL is only the fallback for a client that renders annotations before any call.

description: Hyperscaler AI Deal Tracker — live feed of Stargate, OpenAI, Anthropic, Microsoft, Oracle, CoreWeave, AMD, NVIDIA, sovereign-AI deals. Pulls from dchub news pipeline, extracts $-figures + MW via regex, classifies by actor. 10-min refresh. Use for tracking AI capex events ($1B+/week typical), capacity announcements, and competitive intel. Do NOT use for the full historical M&A comp set (use list_transactions) or a single-deal teardown with grid context (use deal_autopsy); this is the live $1B+ AI-capex feed.

limit.description: Number of recent AI-capex deals to return (default 20)

name: hyperscaler_deals

_return_loop.description: Suggested next-session delta call (get_changes since=24h) so you pull only what changed.

citation.description: Machine-readable citation: how to attribute DC Hub (dchub.cloud) for this payload. Normally an OBJECT {source, url, license, cite_as, retrieved_at}; a bare string is accepted and carries the attribution line itself.
